design.placement: Fixed registered box and bowl positions; only required height support corrections apply.

pickRule: At least 25mm above initial center for five consecutive pre-action frames, with jaw contact in every frame.
placeRule: Sustained pick AND completed contact-v1 placement: supporting corners within rim, fixed inside-height bound, settled speed <.03m/s, no jaw contact throughout final1.5s, full execution.

inspection.notes: Codex reviewed 234 sampled frames across all three cameras for the first four paired trials in baseline, warm and cool lighting. The 12-trial snapshot contains two sustained picks and one strict placement; the sampled visuals agree. These are partial simulation results, not a completed matrix or full-motion review.
